incidents.name: USM FUM defund split-invariance
incidents.notes: USM.defund() prices a FUM redemption off the mean of the current and post-redemption sell price and contracts adjShrinkFactor per call, so redeeming one position in 64 slices paid strictly more ETH than one call - a pure rounding/split-invariance flaw with identical oracle reads throughout the trace.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x2a7FFf44C19f39468064ab5e5c304De01D591675 created 2021-10-10 by 0xc89234ddc6fec3eb20beec3da67bd183c3a4be06, unrelated to attack sender 0xb92b2e47680c89da8f951b8963ef469f461a50fc; no EIP-1967 upgrade events; ~70.8 ETH drained
